issues.what: Arithmetic error in the late-runner sentence: '238 of the 268 big winners are held more than 60 bars'. The study's own hold-bucket table gives 92 (61-120) + 131 (121-375) + 0 (>375) = 223; recomputed from features.parquet (pts >= 50, l1_bars_held > 60, IS): 223 rows, 36 kept, net 1,616,633. The '36 kept' and '1.62M' in the same sentence are correct; 238 is not (it equals 131 + 107, the n and skipped columns of one bucket added together). The same figure was carried into the agent's final summary ('held 61-375 bars: 238 of 268 big winners').
issues.evidence: h1_summary.json results['minute/L1'].big_winners.by_hold: {'61-120': n 92, kept 12}, {'121-375': n 131, kept 24}; max l1_bars_held under L1 = 370 so '>375' is empty; recomputation: big winners held > 60 bars = 223 (kept 36, net 1,616,633).
issues.fix: Change 238 to 223 in FINDINGS.md section 6 and in any downstream summary; the verdict is unaffected (the gate keeps 36 of 223 = 16%, still its base rate).

issues.what: False blanket statement 'Every kept book has mean net < 0 at 5 and at 8 pts slippage'. On 5 min / L0 the take_only kept mean is +126.30 and take_or_reenter_at_setup +133.81 at 5 pts (both < 0 at 8 pts: -263.66 / -256.15). The study's own L0 table two sections later shows the +126.30 / PF 1.046 row, so the prose contradicts the table. L0 is robustness only and both rows fail control (28.9 / 31.4), sign blocks (4) and slip8, so no candidate is affected.

issues.what: Per-group kept-vs-skipped means are computed outside harness.score: group_table() emits kept_mean, skipped_mean and kept_minus_skipped per hour bin / read / direction / visit bin, and FINDINGS quotes them as kept-vs-skipped numbers (hour bins +636, +455, +108 / -279, -148, -479; direction -1,125 vs -989; visit bins -228 / -94 / +94 / -119 / -10). The brief says 'No private kept-vs-skipped arithmetic anywhere'. The study declares these as descriptive decompositions of the frozen ledger row, chose no rule on them, and reports a null result, so nothing in the ledger/PBO/SPA is understated by a candidate; but these per-cell numbers are exactly the uncounted looks the judges' fix targets, and a later study could cherry-pick a cell (e.g. hour 09 +636) without a ledger row.
issues.evidence: h1_gate_audit.py line 123: t['kept_minus_skipped'] = (t.kept_mean - t.skipped_mean).round(2); the 13 h1_<tf>_<label>_by_*.csv files carry that column; none of these cells has a ledger row (ledger has 44 h1 rows: 9 variants x 4 tables + 4 fz_book + 4 post-hoc).
issues.fix: Either drop the kept_minus_skipped column and the per-cell prose from FINDINGS (keep n / kept / net / winners / big per group, which are not kept-vs-skipped statistics), or record in FINDINGS and the ledger (as a note on the frozen row) the number of group cells shown (13 tables, ~90 cells per table) so any follow-up study that keys a rule on one of them counts that family size.

No thresholds searched, no model fit, splitter not needed (stated in caveats); OOS rows appear only through the harness Table and are dropped by is_mask before any statistic; crosscheck opens only h1_1m_IS_by_*.csv and h1_1m_big_winners_skipped_IS.csv under built/study (16 tables agree, same 250 SETUPs, pts 43,050.4). Study folder unchanged since commit d92bd1f; nothing written to data/ or features_ext/; run.log is byte-identical to h1_gate_audit.log. Control percentile semantics checked in fz_report.random_control (fz_pct = share of session-matched draws below FZ net, ties half) and permutation_p (two-sided, +1 corrected) as FINDINGS describes. The ext_features lens items (truncation diff, HMM forward filter, 2021-10..2023-09 fit window) do not apply: this study builds no per-bar feature and did not touch features_ext/. Null result stands; the issues found are a descriptive count (238 -> 223), a prose overstatement contradicted by the study's own L0 table, per-group kept-vs-skipped arithmetic outside the ledger that was not used to choose anything, and a loose 'same numbers' in the agent's summary.
